comparison_limits: 历史两轮实验，每个任务每种模式仅一次最终运行，不能据此证明一般性解决率差异。
RepoMap 的费用与调用数包含 Ripgrep 原始失败尝试及修正启动配置后的重跑；plain 无重跑。
RepoMap 推理时 Gson、Tokio 使用原镜像，之后仅复用原补丁在依赖预热镜像上复评；plain 从推理开始即使用预热镜像。
缓存输入 token 占比是 usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens / usage.prompt_tokens，不是 API 请求命中率。费用来自服务端 usage.cost，不是按本地价格估算。
官方 resolved 只覆盖每条任务规定的判分项，不代表整个仓库全量测试无失败。

once_snapshot.recommendation_rule: Only after every planned trial in a size group is graded with no run/infra errors: choose the smallest budget attaining the group's highest observed resolved count.
limitations: One task per repository and one final run per budget; candidate budgets are exploratory, not general size thresholds.
Search counts identify explicit Bash requests, including log filtering; they exclude custom script searches and internal map scans.
Budget zero is the plain baseline; minimum successful budget zero does not establish that a map can never help.
Costs include completed trials only while running; current in-flight model charges are not included in progress totals.
